prespec.study_weighting_rule: Each STUDYID contributes equal total weight via study_balanced_weights; weights average to 1. Donor studies in a pooled train set receive the same per-study total as target studies. Validation stays target-only.

tuning_rules.spline: Select ridge alpha by validation study-balanced WRMSE on the frozen target-species validation studies. Do not use donor rows for early stopping.
tuning_rules.transformer: Early-stop on validation RMSE. Covariance is the shared spline HierarchicalCovariance (required). Member 0 is the full-train mean; later members are study-bootstrap refits of the mean only.

uncertainty_safeguards.covariance: HierarchicalCovariance on study-level OOF residuals; covariance parameters are not bootstrapped
uncertainty_safeguards.transformer_covariance: shared with the spline; required; not a separately fitted residual

uncertainty.parameter_uncertainty: Spline: study-bootstrap of the mean only (n_bootstrap includes member 0). Transformer: n_members=1, so there is no bootstrap member spread. Covariance parameters are not bootstrapped. Parameter uncertainty is incompletely estimated; do not treat predictive intervals as complete parameter-uncertainty intervals.
uncertainty.predictive_variability: HierarchicalCovariance study, animal, and residual draws in sample_study. This is predictive variability of new-study trajectories under the fitted residual layer.

safeguards.covariance: HierarchicalCovariance on study-level OOF residuals; covariance parameters are not bootstrapped
safeguards.transformer_covariance: shared with the spline; required; not a separately fitted residual
